fact: The Ministry of ICT and National Guidance review of the National Broadband Policy 2018 states that NITA-U has connected 120 ministries, departments and agencies and 53 district local governments to the NBI, with coverage still limited in parts of the country.
title: Review of the implementation of Uganda's National Broadband Policy 2018 and proposed interventions
publisher: International Telecommunication Union / Ministry of ICT and National Guidance
